## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Market shows mixed signals — strong mega-cap tech moves offset by dispersion across cyclicals; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Discretionary leading: AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND. Communication also strong: CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows headline strength via MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate soft: VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION. Industrials underperform: CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: LIN (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND, VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION, WELL (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in a mix of Materials/Real Estate and select Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: MSFT (1W: +21.75%), CHTR (1W: +17.57%), AMZN (1W: +17.00%), ORCL (1W: +12.94%) and ACN (1W: +12.88%). Note major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT surge vs AAPL, NVDA pullbacks) — tactical, not yet structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed/catalyst-driven: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.38% | 1M: -1.41%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -2.94% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION. Tech gains concentrated in large caps; breadth across the sector is uneven despite headline strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials steady: V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION. Sector shows selective strength rather than broad acceleration.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Cautious: PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -3.95% | 1M: -3.60%) BELOW TREND — sector modestly positive but mixed at the stock level.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (MSFT, AMZN, ACN, MA, V) and reduce exposure to stocks in BELOW TREND or CORRECTION (AAPL, NVDA, CAT, QCOM). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but mixed breadth and major divergences argue for selectivity and monitoring of trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through on the gap; AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND — momentum check. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION — watch trend break, NVDA (1W: -2.94% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION — monitor for distribution.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (AMZN, BKNG) — sector breadth improving. BEARISH: Utilities/Real Estate — VST and VTR remain under pressure and may lead defensive underperformance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MSFT: watch consolidation above recent breakout levels for continuation (ABOVE TREND). AAPL: watch 1W downside momentum for deeper CORRECTION. NVDA: monitor for hold above recent support to avoid broader trend break (CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ETN (+80): Eaton flagged record revenue/raised guidance; price action confirming across industrials (ETN price not in detailed feed here — monitor for follow-through). APD (+80): Air Products beat/raised outlook; sector cyclical confirmation expected. ABBV (+80): EU approval for RINVOQ — watch underlying price action for confirmation (price not in detailed feed here).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (-50): KeyBanc downside call; price in CORRECTION (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) — news aligns with price weakness (confirming). CVX (-50): Negative headlines on leadership/positioning; CVX (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +18.79%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from strong price, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given big-cap tech leadership but mixed breadth (Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive). MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, NVDA in CORRECTION) and clustered leadership (Narrow — 3/5 Technology) that warrants selective positioning and close monitoring of news-confirmation.
